comment: Flange per the CAT40 (V-flange) standard (ASME B5.50, flange 2.50 in = 63.5 mm); the body and nose are a conservative generic envelope for collision checks; nose about 44.5 mm across, for 3/4 in bore face mills. Measure your own holders and correct the segments.
name: CAT40 shell mill arbour 3/4 in pilot, 50.8 mm gauge
